source.data_source: CFL3D and FUN3D solutions on TMR's 545x385 grid (208896 cells) with Spalart-Allmaras turbulence model

mesh_cell_count.description: Total cell count of the 2D flat-plate mesh
mesh_cell_count.T_good_source: TMR reference grid is 545x385 (~210k); a wall-resolved 2D RANS mesh of ~40k is a realistic minimum for moderate Re=5e6. Hand-set.

final_residual_U.description: Final residual of the momentum equation at end of simulation
final_residual_U.T_good_source: Hand-set; steady-state RANS on a flat plate should reach 1e-5

cf_x097.description: Skin-friction coefficient C_f at x=0.9700 on the plate
cf_x097.T_good_source: Inter-code spread (CFL3D vs FUN3D on same grid) is < 1e-6; T_good widened to ~4% to allow for minor differences in mesh topology / turbulence model variant

drag_coefficient.description: Integrated viscous drag coefficient over the full plate length
drag_coefficient.T_good_source: Inter-code spread is ~8e-6; T_good widened to accommodate mesh + model choices
